serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
Riots seem to be mostly over.
The local government is back in control, or at least it says so.
Looking at the streets it does seem to be true. Nothing is on fire anymore, most of the smoke is gone.
Streets are full of busy people going to work or college, even though there’s still a lot of debris and other filth laying around.
I can only hope for the best…
